name: Button
summary: Trigger for an action or navigation. The primary interactive control.

a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 2026-08-27 (apps/keyboard-probe + tests/visual/teclado-motor.spec.ts). Confirmed: Enter, Space.

props.name: variant
props.type: primary | secondary | outline | ghost | primary-outline | primary-ghost | danger | danger-outline | danger-ghost | link | link-primary | link-danger | nav
props.description: Atalho para o par (appearance, tone). Os treze nomes continuam valendo e pintam exatamente o mesmo; a API de dois eixos é appearance + tone.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Quanto peso a caixa tem. nav é aparência própria (item de navegação), não um tom.

props.name: tone
props.type: neutral | brand | danger | success | warning | info
props.description: O que a cor significa. Todos os tons funcionam em todas as aparências, inclusive preenchido — cada um tem par cor+texto próprio por tema.

props.name: size
props.description: Height comes from the density tokens; the pill radius never changes.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders an <a> with the same skin. A button that navigates is a link.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows the spinner, sets aria-busy and blocks interaction. The label stays.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Native disabled: the control leaves the tab order entirely. With href it becomes aria-disabled, since a link has no disabled state. USE IT WHEN THERE IS NOTHING TO EXPLAIN — measured on 2026-08-13, a disabled button cannot be focused, so a Tooltip hung on it is never read by anyone navigating with a keyboard, and wrapping it in a span (what other libraries document) fixes the pointer and not the keyboard, because the span comes in at tabIndex -1.

props.name: aria-disabled
props.description: Inert but REACHABLE: the control keeps its place in the tab order and announces itself as disabled, and this component blocks activation — the attribute is semantics only, so leaving it to the browser would announce "disabled" on a button that still acts. Use it when there IS a why to tell, and put the why in a Tooltip, which now reaches. There is no permission component in Aurea and there will not be one: hiding an action is {can ? … : …} in your own code, and hiding a button is not security — see ADR-0023.

props.name: type
props.description: Deliberately not submit: a Cancel inside a form must not fire the main action.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretches to the container. Only the width changes — the pill radius is invariant.

props.name: pressed
props.description: DEPRECATED since 0.4.0, removed in 1.0 — use `<Toggle>`. It only paints and announces (aria-pressed) and YOU keep the state; Toggle owns the state, returns onPressedChange and demands an accessible name when it is icon-only. Twelve reference libraries were read on 18/08/2026 (MUI, Fluent 2, React Aria, Spectrum, Carbon, Radix/Base UI, shadcn, ReUI, PrimeReact, HeroUI, Cedar, W3C APG) and NONE puts the pressed state on the plain button. Toggle state via aria-pressed: on shows the raised capsule with a yellow underline.

props.name: kbd
props.description: Shortcut shown as a Kbd inside the button and announced with aria-keyshortcuts.

props.name: grow
props.description: In a row (Cluster), takes an equal share with the other buttons that also grow (C-03). `fullWidth` asks for the whole line instead.

props.name: target
props.description: Link attribute, only with `href` (C-13). It always reached the <a> at runtime; now the type accepts it, so target="_blank" compiles.
